faq.question: Q1. What is KAU Analyst Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification by Kerala Agricultural University to select 4 Analysts on a contract basis for the World Bank KERA project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for KAU Analyst?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies available for the Analyst post.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview for KAU Analyst 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 15.10.2026 at 9.00 am.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the KAU Analyst walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at Agricultural Research Station Mannuthy.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for KAU Analyst?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MSc Chemistry degree.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for KAU Analyst Recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for KAU Analyst?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated wage of 25000/ month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a contractual basis for a period of 6 months.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.
